model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and ACC (%) for six different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5.

The Base model is represented by a black line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 38% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and increasing to around 45% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3. The FT model is depicted by a blue line with triangular markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 40% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and rising to approximately 48% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3. The IKE model is shown as a red line with triangular markers and a solid line style, commencing at about 44% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and reaching around 50% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3. The MEND model is represented by a brown line with diamond markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 46% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and increasing to around 57% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3. The MEMIT model is illustrated by a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 45% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and rising to approximately 55% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3. The ROME model is depicted by a green line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 51% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 4 and increasing to approximately 66% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 2 x 10^3.
